meta.sourceName: EA Marked patch notes + The Apex Legends Wiki

items.name: Bloodhound
items.title: Technological Tracker
items.description: A Recon Legend rebuilt for Season 30 as a squad hunter: glowing tracks reveal movement, Eye of the Allfather supplies sustained scans, and Allfather's Cloak conceals the squad.

abilities.name: Tracker
abilities.description: Fresh enemy clues leave red trails. White Ravens can fly up to 400 meters toward nearby enemies and can be activated by looking at them from range.

abilities.name: Eye of the Allfather
abilities.description: Reveal enemies through structures for 3 seconds, followed by four snapshots at 1.5-second intervals.

abilities.name: Allfather's Cloak
abilities.description: Deploy an 8-second device that cloaks every Legend in range, including enemies. Cloak lingers for 12 seconds after leaving, grants +20% movement speed and threat vision, and breaks on damage, weapon fire, or most abilities.

options.name: Hidden Sight
options.description: Activating Allfather's Cloak refreshes Eye of the Allfather. Using the tactical while cloaked hides its scan visual from enemies.

options.name: Bird's Eye
options.description: White Ravens split and fly toward the two nearest enemies belonging to different squads.

options.name: Hunter's Agility
options.description: Reduces Eye of the Allfather activation time by 20% and its cooldown by 5 seconds.

options.name: True Predator
options.description: Firing a weapon while cloaked only interrupts the cloak temporarily instead of breaking it permanently. Respawn did not publish the re-cloak delay.

seasonOverride.name: EA Marked Patch Notes
seasonOverride.noteZh: 30.0 官方补丁覆盖 Wiki 快照中的英雄改动字段。

items.name: Gibraltar
items.title: Shielded Fortress
items.description: Gibraltar is a Support Legend who has been available since launch. He is able to protect himself with his Gun Shield , and can create a temporary safe zone with his Dome of Protection . He can also call in a Defensive Bombardment to create a temporary unsafe zone for enemies.

abilities.name: Gun Shield
abilities.description: Aiming down sights deploys a gun shield that blocks incoming fire.

abilities.name: Dome of Protection
abilities.description: Blocks incoming and outgoing attacks.

abilities.name: Defensive Bombardment
abilities.description: Call in a concentrated mortar strike on a marked position.

options.name: Thunder Dome
options.description: Electrified Dome of Protection deals 50 damage and slow the first enemy to cross.

options.name: Healing Dome
options.description: Dome of Protection duration increases 4s (12s→16s). and heal double for players while in the Dome of Protection.

options.name: Triple Bombardment
options.description: Get 3 charges of the Defensive Bombardment with smaller radius.

options.name: Fast Shotties
options.description: Move at holstered speed while using shotguns and auto-reload shotguns on knock.

items.name: Lifeline
items.title: Combat Medic
items.description: Lifeline is a Support Legend who was released with the game's launch, and was heavily reworked in Season 23 . She can use her Combat Glide to save downed allies automatically and briefly glide. Her D.O.C. Heal Drone can be deployed to restore health without using items, and her D.O.C. Halo can allow herself and teammates to use healing items faster and behind cover.

abilities.name: Combat Glide
abilities.description: Hold mid-air to use D.O.C. to briefly glide. Deploy D.O.C to revive teammates, leaving Lifeline free to defend.

abilities.name: D.O.C. Heal Drone
abilities.description: D.O.C. heals all nearby allies. D.O.C. can be assigned to follow allies once deployed.

abilities.name: D.O.C. Halo
abilities.description: Throw D.O.C. to activate his Halo Shield System. All players inside use Health & Shield consumables faster.

options.name: Extended Flight
options.description: Increase Combat Glide time by 1.5s (4s → 5.5s).

options.name: Battpack
options.description: Carry +1 per stack (2 → 3) and see batteries counter over Death Boxes.

options.name: Enhanced Radio
options.description: D.O.C. Heal Drone assignment range +50%.

options.name: Tactical Cooldown+
options.description: D.O.C. Heal Drone cooldown reduced by 10 seconds (45s → 35s).

items.name: Pathfinder
items.title: Forward Scout
items.description: Pathfinder is a Skirmisher Legend who has been available since launch. His Grappling Hook is a powerful and quick mobility tool, as is his Zipline Gun , a quick and simple way to get his whole squad from one spot to another. His Insider Knowledge gives him a way to quickly charge a new zipline.

abilities.name: Insider Knowledge
abilities.description: Scan a Care Package, Ring Console, or Survey Beacon to recharge 25% of the Zipline Gun and permanently reduce its cooldown by 10s.

abilities.name: Grappling Hook
abilities.description: Grapple to get to out-of-reach places quickly.

abilities.name: Zipline Gun
abilities.description: Create a zipline for everyone to use. Riders take 50% less damage while its energized.

options.name: Field Research
options.description: Gain access to Recon perks.

options.name: Ringmaster
options.description: Gain access to Controller perks.

options.name: Landing Gear
options.description: Gain better air control and softer landings.

options.name: Feeling Zippy
options.description: +1 Zipline Gun charge and improve ally energized speed.

items.name: Wraith
items.title: Interdimensional Skirmisher
items.description: Wraith is a Skirmisher Legend who has been available since launch. She is able to escape dangerous situations with Into the Void , and can create safe passage for her squad using a Dimensional Rift . Her Voices from the Void warn her in advance when enemies or traps are near.

abilities.name: Voices from the Void
abilities.description: A voice warns you when danger approaches. As far as you can tell, it's on your side.

abilities.name: Into the Void
abilities.description: Reposition quickly through the safety of void space, avoiding all damage.

abilities.name: Dimensional Rift
abilities.description: Link two locations with portals for 45 seconds, allowing anyone to use them.

options.name: Sixth Sense
options.description: Voices from the Void warns you when a new squad comes within 150 meters.

options.name: Phase Dome
options.description: While casting Dimensional Rift, the portal entrance gains a Phase Dome, phasing anyone inside of it.

options.name: Fast Phase
options.description: Into the Void activates 30% faster (0.8s → 0.5s).

options.name: Void Jumper
options.description: Into the Void's duration increased by 2 seconds (4s → 6s) and enables the ability to perform a double jump while in the void.

items.name: Bangalore
items.title: Professional Soldier
items.description: Bangalore is an Assault Legend who has been available since launch. She can blind enemies with her Smoke Launcher and deploy Rolling Thunder to force them to take cover. When enemies open fire at her, Double Time kicks in to give her the speed to escape.

abilities.name: Double Time
abilities.description: Taking fire while sprinting makes you move faster for a brief time.

abilities.name: Smoke Launcher
abilities.description: Fire a high-velocity smoke canister that explodes into a smoke wall on impact.

abilities.name: Rolling Thunder
abilities.description: Call in an artillery strike that slowly creeps across the landscape, starting left from the flare's position.

options.name: Electric Smoke
options.description: Smoke Launcher now deals 100 damage to enemy deployables.

options.name: Cover Me!
options.description: Allies regenerate HP while inside smoke. Auto-ping enemies who trigger Double Time.

options.name: ECM Payload
options.description: Rolling Thunder deals 10 more damage (40 → 50 dmg) and destroys all enemy deployables.

options.name: Medal of Honor
options.description: Revive allies 25% faster. Double Time activates when running toward knocked allies.

items.name: Caustic
items.title: Toxic Trapper
items.description: Caustic is a Controller Legend who has been available since launch. He can use his Nox Gas Traps and Nox Gas Grenade to coat a wide area in toxic gas, slowing and blinding enemies while his Nox Vision gives him immunity.

abilities.name: Field Research
abilities.description: Gain extra upgrade points by causing damage with gas, opening deathboxes and scanning ring consoles.

abilities.name: Nox Gas Trap
abilities.description: Place up to 6 canisters that release deadly Nox gas when shot or triggered by enemies. Nox Gas damages and grounds enemies.

abilities.name: Nox Gas Grenade
abilities.description: Blankets a large area in Nox Gas. Nox Gas damages and grounds enemies

options.name: Extra Traps
options.description: +1 Nox Gas Trap charge and +2 traps in the world.

options.name: Breathe It In
options.description: Regenerate 1 HP/sec while inside Nox gas.

options.name: Particle Diffuser
options.description: Nox Gas Grenade has 50% larger radius.

options.name: Gas Fighter
options.description: Nox Gas Trap recharges 300% faster while inside Nox gas.

items.name: Mirage
items.title: Holographic Trickster
items.description: Mirage is a Support Legend who has been available since launch. He can make decoys of himself using Psyche Out and Life of the Party to distract and confuse enemies, and can turn invisible while reviving squadmates thanks to Now You See Me... .

abilities.name: Now You See Me...
abilities.description: Automatically cloak when using Respawn Beacons and reviving teammates. Spawn a decoy and cloak when downed.

abilities.name: Psyche Out
abilities.description: Send out a holographic decoy to confuse the enemy. Press ⧄ to control the decoy.

abilities.name: Life of the Party
abilities.description: Mirage deploys a team of controllable decoys to distract enemies.

options.name: Renaissance Man
options.description: Gain access to all class world interactions (Assault Bins, Care Package scans, Survey Beacons, and Ring Consoles).

options.name: Boozle-Eye
options.description: Bamboozles also scan the enemy who shoots the decoy.

options.name: Me Two
options.description: +1 Psyche Out charge. You can have two active decoys at once.

options.name: Bamboozle Bonus
options.description: Psyche Out cooldown resets after a successful bamboozle.

items.name: Octane
items.title: High-Speed Daredevil
items.description: Octane is a Skirmisher Legend who was introduced in Season 1 . He can use Stim to bolster his speed at the cost of his health, and his Swift Mend helps by regenerating his health over time. He can also throw down a Launch Pad to boost himself and his squad across long distances.

abilities.name: Swift Mend
abilities.description: Automatically restores health over time.

abilities.name: Stim
abilities.description: Increase walk speed by 30% and sprint speed by 40% for 6 seconds. Costs Health to use. Reduction to slows while active.

abilities.name: Launch Pad
abilities.description: Deploy a jump pad that catapults anyone through the air. Press the jump button to double jump.

options.name: Thick Skin
options.description: Take 25% less self-damage from Stim (20 dmg → 15 dmg).

options.name: Squad Rush
options.description: All Launch Pad users gain Stim on landing.

options.name: Daredevil
options.description: Increase Stim Surge duration the less HP you have (up to 6 seconds).

options.name: Triple Jump
options.description: Gain a third jump from Launch Pads.

items.name: Wattson
items.title: Static Defender
items.description: Wattson is a Controller Legend who was introduced in Season 2 . She can defend against advancing squads by placing Perimeter Security to shock intruders, and an Interception Pylon to shoot down ordnance. She can also use Spark of Genius to recharge her ultimate and her shields.

abilities.name: Spark of Genius
abilities.description: Ultimate Accelerant s fully charge Wattson's ultimate. She can also carry more Ultimate Accelerants and use them faster. Wattson slowly restores her shields over time.

abilities.name: Perimeter Security
abilities.description: Create electrified fences by connecting nodes. Fences damage and slow enemies. Fences near doors will electrify them.

abilities.name: Interception Pylon
abilities.description: Place an electrified pylon (Max: 1) that destroys incoming ordnance and repairs damaged shields. Intercepted ordnances are converted into Arc Stars.

options.name: Help is Here
options.description: Gain all Support class perks.

options.name: Ultimate Conductor
options.description: Damage dealt converts to Ultimate charge. Knocks grant a 50% burst of charge.

options.name: Energized Healer
options.description: Double the healing effect of small healing items ( and ).

options.name: Power Pylon
options.description: Interception Pylon gains double HP (300 HP Total), healing rate, and capacity.

items.name: Crypto
items.title: Surveillance Expert
items.description: Crypto is a Recon Legend who was introduced in Season 3 . He can fly his Surveillance Drone to spy on and distract enemies, and fly close to scan them with Neurolink . He can also activate a Drone EMP to remotely destroy enemy defenses and shields.

abilities.name: Neurolink
abilities.description: Crypto and his teammates see what his Surveillance Drone detects up to a 30m distance.

abilities.name: Surveillance Drone
abilities.description: Deploy an aerial camera drone that can remotely interact with Survey Beacons , Respawn Beacons , and ally Banner cards.

abilities.name: Drone EMP
abilities.description: Charge up an EMP from your drone. The blast deals 50 shield damage, slows players, and destroys traps.

options.name: Network Expansion
options.description: +25% range on Neurolink and Drone EMP. (30 m → 37.5 m)

options.name: Ally.MoveTo()
options.description: Crypto can Trailblaze to all allies.

options.name: Power Coupling
options.description: Crypto gains Ultimate charge from using scan beacons and scanning enemies with his drone.

options.name: Hackathon
options.description: Surveillance Drone cooldown reduced by 20 seconds (40s → 20s) and gain speed boost when activating Drone EMP or losing the drone.

items.name: Revenant
items.title: Synthetic Nightmare
items.description: Revenant is an Assault Legend who was introduced in Season 4 , and was heavily reworked in Season 18 . He specializes in closing the distance between himself and enemies with Shadow Pounce . His Assassin's Instinct passive allows him to crouch walk faster, climb higher, and see nearby low health enemies. He can also activate Forged Shadows to give himself a larger health pool.

abilities.name: Assassin's Instinct
abilities.description: Highlights nearby visible enemies that are low on health. You crouch walk faster and have improved wall climbing.

abilities.name: Shadow Pounce
abilities.description: Unleash a powerful pounce forwards. Hold to charge for further distance.

abilities.name: Forged Shadows
abilities.description: Forge a shroud of hardened shadows around you that block damage and regenerate. Knockdowns will start regenerating your shadows.

options.name: Ultimate Cooldown
options.description: Forged Shadows cooldown reduced by 30 seconds (180s → 150s).

options.name: Try To Hide
options.description: Assassin's Instinct low health markers last twice as long.

options.name: Tactical Cooldown
options.description: Shadow Pounce cooldown reduced by 5 seconds (20s → 15s).

options.name: Agile Assassin
options.description: Shadow Pounce activates and charge 50% faster.

items.name: Loba
items.title: Translocating Thief
items.description: Loba is a Support Legend who was introduced in Season 5 . She is excellent at finding high-tier items with her Eye for Quality and safely stealing them with her Black Market Boutique . She can also use her Burglar's Best Friend to teleport through even the smallest gaps in a wall.

abilities.name: Eye for Quality
abilities.description: Nearby epic and legendary loot can be seen through walls. The range is the same as Black Market Boutique . Open loot vaults without a key.

abilities.name: Burglar's Best Friend
abilities.description: Teleport to hard-to-reach places or escape trouble quickly by throwing your jump drive bracelet.

abilities.name: Black Market Boutique
abilities.description: Place a portable device that allows you to teleport nearby loot to your inventory. Ammo, small meds and teammate banners are free.

options.name: Wolf's Claws
options.description: After teleporting with Burglar's Best Friend, get a speed boost and super fast weapon draw.

options.name: Shopping Spree
options.description: Your squad can take +1 extra item from Black Market Boutique (2 → 3).

options.name: Escape Artist
options.description: After teleporting with Burglar's Best Friend, regenerate 25 shield HP (until taking damage).

options.name: Brand New Bag
options.description: Gain one Purple Backpack in the next Care Package.

items.name: Rampart
items.title: Amped Modder
items.description: Rampart is a Controller Legend who was introduced in Season 6 . She can place Amped Cover to both defend her squad and boost her firepower. She can mow down enemies with light machine guns bolstered by Modded Loader , or with her signature Mobile Minigun "Sheila" .

abilities.name: Battle Modder
abilities.description: Increased magazine / heat capacity and faster reloads / recharge when using LMGs and the Minigun. Amped Cover permanently gains health with each Evo level.

abilities.name: Amped Cover
abilities.description: Build a crouch-cover wall, which deploys a full-cover amped wall that blocks incoming shots and amps outgoing shots. Damage through or to Amped Cover charges the wall. Passing over the wall converts charges to a speed boost. (Max: 5)

abilities.name: Mobile Minigun "Sheila"
abilities.description: Wield a mobile minigun with a single high capacity magazine. Place it down for anyone to use as a stationary and reloadable turret (Max: [1])

options.name: Combat Reserve
options.description: Gain extra ammo per inventory stack, extra grenade capacity, and automatically reload a stowed weapon. Red Weapon Supply Bin access was removed.

options.name: Locked and Loaded
options.description: Faster reloads and infinite ammo when behind Amped Cover and Amped Shield is intact.

options.name: Ramped Up
options.description: Mobile Minigun "Sheila"'s handling and spin-up time are improved by 20%.

options.name: Rebuild Module
options.description: Amped Cover will regenerate after not being damaged for a period of time.

seasonOverride.name: EA Marked Patch Notes
seasonOverride.noteZh: 30.0 官方补丁覆盖 Wiki 快照中的英雄改动字段。

items.name: Horizon
items.title: Gravitational Manipulator
items.description: Horizon is a Skirmisher Legend who was introduced in Season 7 . Specializing in vertical movement, she can use her Gravity Lift to ascend easily and her Spacewalk to better control her descent. She can also throw out a Black Hole to pull in fleeing enemies.

abilities.name: Spacewalk
abilities.description: Increase air control and reduce fall impacts with Horizon’s custom spacesuit.

abilities.name: Gravity Lift
abilities.description: Reverses the flow of gravity, lifting players upward and boosting them outward when they exit.

abilities.name: Black Hole
abilities.description: Deploy N.E.W.T. to create a micro black hole that pulls players in towards it.

options.name: Gravity Boots
options.description: Pressing while in the air makes the player fall much faster.

options.name: NEWT Scoot
options.description: After leaving Gravity Lift, press and holds while in the air makes you fall much slower.

options.name: Conservation Of Energy
options.description: Spacewalk now regenerates 25 shield HP when you soft land.

options.name: Knock Expert
options.description: +1 extra ability charge on knock.

items.name: Fuse
items.title: Bombastic Explosives Expert
items.description: Fuse is an Assault Legend who was introduced in Season 8 . He can make better use of grenades thanks to his Grenadier ability, and can add to the pressure with his Knuckle Cluster . He can also launch The Motherlode to cover an area in explosives.

abilities.name: Grenadier
abilities.description: Stack an extra grenade per inventory slot. Fire grenades farther, faster, and more accurately.

abilities.name: Knuckle Cluster
abilities.description: Launch a cluster bomb that continuously expels airburst explosives on impact.

abilities.name: The Motherlode
abilities.description: Launch a bomb that scatters explosives around its landing point. Aim down sights to launch a cover-piercing bomb.

options.name: Pyro Techniques
options.description: The Motherlode drops behind patches of fire for 8 seconds after the bombs explode

options.name: Knuckle Jumper
options.description: Jumping when next to your own Knuckle Cluster will give you an explosive boost (destroys the cluster afterwards).

options.name: Reignition
options.description: Dealing explosive damage to enemies recharges your ultimate (for every 2 damage dealt, reduces cooldown by 1 second).

options.name: Wreckless
options.description: -50% damage taken from explosives.

items.name: Valkyrie
items.title: Winged Avenger
items.description: Valkyrie is a Recon Legend who was introduced in Season 9 . Her VTOL Jets give her excellent mobility in the air, and her Skyward Dive can be used to reposition her team and land on unsuspecting squads. She can also use her Missile Swarm to flush out enemies hiding behind cover.

abilities.name: VTOL Jets
abilities.description: Press the jump key while in the air to engage jetpack. You can switch between hold and toggle mode in the options menu.

abilities.name: Missile Swarm
abilities.description: Fire a swarm of mini-rockets that damage and disorient the enemy.

abilities.name: Skyward Dive
abilities.description: Press once to prepare for launch. Teammates can interact with Valkyrie to join the launch. Press again to launch into the air and skydive.

options.name: Eyes in the Sky
options.description: Reveal enemies through walls within 100 meters while skydiving; enemies in line of sight can still be revealed within 250 meters.

options.name: Full Coverage
options.description: Missile Swarm fires more missiles (4x3 pattern → 4x5 pattern) and gets 5 seconds shorter cooldown (30s → 25s).

options.name: Supersonic
options.description: Reduce Skyward Dive launch time by 40% (5.0s → 3.0s).

options.name: Aerial Expert
options.description: Decreases jetpack activation cost, increased horizontal speed. Consumes fuel slightly faster.

seasonOverride.name: EA Marked Patch Notes
seasonOverride.noteZh: 30.0 官方补丁覆盖 Wiki 快照中的英雄改动字段。

items.name: Seer
items.title: Ambush Artist
items.description: Seer is a Recon Legend who was introduced in Season 10 . He can detect nearby enemies with his Heart Seeker and hit them with his Focus of Attention , revealing them and disabling their abilities. He can also deploy an Exhibit to reveal loud enemies.

abilities.name: Heart Seeker
abilities.description: Hear and visualize the heartbeats of enemies within 75m when aiming down sights, if enemies are beyond this range the marker turns blue and pulsates with less intensity with a limit of ~90m

abilities.name: Focus of Attention
abilities.description: Summon micro-drones to emit a delayed blast that goes through walls silencing and revealing enemies.

abilities.name: Exhibit
abilities.description: Create a sphere of micro-drones that reveal the location of enemies moving quickly or firing their weapons within. You can double jump while inside the sphere.

options.name: Lasting Beats
options.description: Enemies that leave your ultimate radius are highlighted for 5 seconds.

options.name: Energizing Focus
options.description: Landing your tactical on an enemy regenerates 25 shields (non-stackable).

options.name: Home Base
options.description: While you’re inside of your Ultimate radius your Tactical cooldown is reduced to 8 seconds.

options.name: Split Focus
options.description: +1 Focus of Attention charge.

items.name: Ash
items.title: Incisive Instigator
items.description: Ash is a Skirmisher Legend who was introduced in Season 11 . She received a passive rework in Season 24 . She can throw an Arc Snare to prevent an opponent from escaping, and can quickly advance with her squad through a Phase Breach . She can also use her Predator's Pursuit to dash in the air.

abilities.name: Predator's Pursuit
abilities.description: Press while in the air to perform a dash.

abilities.name: Arc Snare
abilities.description: Throw a spinning snare that damages and tethers the first enemy that gets too close.

abilities.name: Phase Breach
abilities.description: Tear open a one-way portal to a targeted location.

options.name: Longer Reach
options.description: Increases Phase Breach range by 25m.

options.name: Ultimate Cooldown
options.description: Reduces Phase Breach cooldown by 30s.

options.name: Twin Snares
options.description: +1 Arc Snare charge.

options.name: Greedy Snare
options.description: Arc Snare lifetime tripled (5s → 15s) and it can snare multiple enemies.

items.name: Mad Maggie
items.title: Rebel Warlord
items.description: Mad Maggie is an Assault Legend who was introduced in Season 12 . She can breach buildings by firing a Riot Drill to damage enemies through walls or by tossing a Wrecking Ball to burst through defenses. Her Warlord's Ire passive lets her run faster when wielding shotguns.

abilities.name: Warlord's Ire
abilities.description: Temporarily highlight enemies you've damaged. / Move faster with shotguns.

abilities.name: Riot Drill
abilities.description: Fire a drill that attaches to an obstacle and burns enemies on the other side.

abilities.name: Wrecking Ball
abilities.description: Throw a ball that releases speed-boosting pads and detonates near enemies.

options.name: Gunrunning
options.description: Movement speed increased while holding SMGs and Pistols.

options.name: Fire Ball
options.description: Wrecking Ball drops magma patches on the ground and Mad Maggie takes 50% less fire damage.

options.name: Drillslinger
options.description: +1 Riot Drill charge, but -25% drill duration (9s → 6.75s).

options.name: Big Drill
options.description: +50% Riot Drill width and depth.

items.name: Newcastle
items.title: Heroic Defender
items.description: Newcastle is a Support Legend who was introduced in Season 13 . He specializes in creating cover for his squadmates using his Mobile Shield and his Castle Wall , and can revive downed squadmates while moving and holding up a Knockdown Shield thanks to his passive, Retrieve the Wounded .

abilities.name: Retrieve the Wounded
abilities.description: Drag downed allies as you revive and protect them with your Revive Shield.

abilities.name: Mobile Shield
abilities.description: Throw a drone that projects a moveable energy shield.

abilities.name: Castle Wall
abilities.description: Leap to an ally or target area and slam down, creating a fortified stronghold.

options.name: Stronghold
options.description: Castle Wall gets +500 HP (1250 HP total) and electrification lasts 120 seconds longer (120s → 240s).

options.name: Ready To Rumble
options.description: Reviving a player auto loads Newcastle's weapons and triggers full regen.

options.name: Ultimate Savior
options.description: When you slam down Castle Wall, allies in the impact zone get 15 seconds of shield regeneration.

options.name: Defensive Line
options.description: Tactical and Revive Shield knocks back enemies once.

items.name: Vantage
items.title: Sniper Savant
items.description: Vantage is a Recon Legend who was introduced in Season 14 . She excels at using sniper rifles thanks to her Spotter's Lens , and can weaken enemies from afar with shots from her Sniper's Mark . She can also use Echo Relocation to cross long distances with ease.

abilities.name: Spotter's Lens
abilities.description: Aim down sights to scout with your eyepiece to see enemy healthbars and team shield levels. Ping to track multiple far away targets. Mid- to long-range scopes show bullet drop indicator to see where your shots will land.

abilities.name: Echo Relocation
abilities.description: Position your winged companion Echo and then Launch toward him. Must be looking towards Echo to launch. Gain a Double Jump when you reach Echo, or crouch to cancel the jump early.

abilities.name: Sniper's Mark
abilities.description: Use your custom sniper rifle to mark enemy targets which applies a damage bonus for you and your team. Shooting will enable a targeting laser for a short duration when aiming down sights.

options.name: Controlling my Prey
options.description: Gain all Controller class perks.

options.name: Improved Mark
options.description: Sniper's Mark marked enemies are briefly highlighted, their icon is visible through walls and their health bar is revealed to the squad.

options.name: Herd Tracker
options.description: Marking an enemy with Spotter's Lens marks the entire team.

options.name: Sniper Cover
options.description: Adds a Gun Shield to Sniper's Mark.

items.name: Catalyst
items.title: Defensive Conjurer
items.description: Catalyst is a Controller Legend who was introduced in Season 15 . She is able to quickly lock down an area by reinforcing doorways with Barricade , laying hazardous Piercing Spikes , and blocking out vision with her Dark Veil .

abilities.name: Barricade
abilities.description: Reinforce doors, strengthening them and locking them to enemies. Spaces where doors have been destroyed can also be reinforced.

abilities.name: Piercing Spikes
abilities.description: Throw out a patch of ferrofluid which turns in to spikes when enemies are near. Catalyst remains immune to enemy spikes.

abilities.name: Dark Veil
abilities.description: Raise a permeable wall of ferrofluid. Enemies who walk through it will be slowed and partially blinded for a brief time.

options.name: Hidden Spikes
options.description: Piercing Spikes are hidden while dormant.

options.name: Sole Piercer
options.description: Piercing Spikes activate twice as fast and deal more damages (15 → 20).

options.name: Ferro-Door
options.description: Using Barricade on destroyed doors rebuilds the door.

options.name: Resilient Veil
options.description: Dark Veil lasts 5 seconds longer (15s → 20s).

items.name: Ballistic
items.title: Refined Gunslinger
items.description: Ballistic is an Assault Legend who was introduced in Season 17 . He is able to bolster his weapon use by carrying an additional weapon in his Sling , and powers up his reloading and weapon handling with Tempest . He can also briefly disable an enemy's weapon with his Whistler .

abilities.name: Sling
abilities.description: Store a third weapon in the sling. Access either via inventory or Character Utility Action. The sling weapon cannot take attachments.

abilities.name: Whistler
abilities.description: Shoots a projectile that heats up an enemy's gun as they shoot. Overheating causes damage. Hold the tactical to lock-on.

abilities.name: Tempest
abilities.description: When activated, nearby teammates get faster reloads and infinite ammo. Ballistic's sling weapon will be equipped and upgraded to gold .

options.name: Extra Bullet
options.description: +1 Whistler charge.

options.name: Trap Mode
options.description: Whistler dart duration tripled (5s → 15s) and dart damage increased to 35 damage.

options.name: Killing Time
options.description: Tempest duration increased by 15s (30s → 45s).

options.name: Quiet Time
options.description: Whistler silences the player on impact instead of applying Overheat and also applies a 0.5s slowdown.

items.name: Conduit
items.title: Shield Healer
items.description: Conduit is a Support Legend who was introduced in Season 19 . She can use Radiant Transfer on herself and a teammate to generate shields for both, and can use her Savior's Speed to catch up with distant allies. Her Energy Barricade can be used to slow enemies in a wide area.

abilities.name: Savior's Speed
abilities.description: Sprint faster towards allies that are out of range of your tactical.

abilities.name: Radiant Transfer
abilities.description: Send a surge of energy to a teammate and yourself, temporarily regenerating shields when in danger.

abilities.name: Energy Barricade
abilities.description: Deploy an array of shield jamming devices which damage and slow enemies.

options.name: Battpack
options.description: Carry +1 per stack (2 → 3) and see batteries counter over Death Boxes.

options.name: Bigger Jam
options.description: Energy Barricade radius is increased by 10% (10m → 11m).

options.name: Instant Barrier
options.description: A portion of Radiant Transfer's charge is applied instantly.

options.name: Enduring Barrier
options.description: Radiant Transfer's regen no longer gets paused when damaged.

items.name: Alter
items.title: Void Breacher
items.description: Alter is a Skirmisher Legend who was introduced in Season 21 . A master of the Void, she can open a portal through a solid surface with her Void Passage and use Gift From The Rift to snatch an item from a distant Death Box. When in a tough spot, her Void Nexus device allows her teammates to teleport back to a safe point.

abilities.name: Gift From The Rift
abilities.description: Can remotely interact with a deathbox to claim one item. Cannot be a shield core.

abilities.name: Void Passage
abilities.description: Creates a portal passageway through a surface.

abilities.name: Void Nexus
abilities.description: Create a regroup point that all allies can remotely interact with to open a phase tunnel back to that location.

options.name: Eye to Another World
options.description: Gain all Recon class perks.

options.name: Controller of Worlds
options.description: Gain all Controller class perks.

options.name: Staring into the Void
options.description: Increases Void Passage scan time for Alter by 15 extra seconds.

options.name: Void Breacher
options.description: Using a friendly Void Passage grants faster movement speed and reloads.

items.name: Sparrow
items.title: Agile Archer
items.description: Sparrow is a Recon Legend introduced in Season 25 .

abilities.name: Double Jump
abilities.description: Allows the character to jump again while in the air. Jumping while climbing will launch Sparrow up the wall. The character can carry additional arrows and explosive arrows for the Bocek.

abilities.name: Tracker Dart
abilities.description: Shoots a tracker from the gauntlet to reveal enemies who walk within its line of sight. These darts can also activate Survey Beacons from a distance.

abilities.name: Stinger Bolt
abilities.description: Shoots a large arrow that anchors where it lands. After charging up, it will shock anyone within its range, causing damage and slowing down opponents it hits.

options.name: Hunt Target
options.description: Speed boost when running towards an enemy marked by Tracker Dart.

options.name: Extra Traps
options.description: +1 Tracker Dart charge and +1 traps in the world.

options.name: Life Syphon
options.description: Health and shield recovery upon damaging enemy with Stinger Bolt.

options.name: Alternate Mode
options.description: +2 Stinger Bolt charges (Total 3), but has fewer pulses and a smaller radius.

items.name: Axle
items.title: Combat Racer
items.description: Axle is a Skirmisher Legend introduced in Season 29 . She can deploy a Nitro Gate to give anyone that steps on it a massive speed boost that also forces them into a slide. Her sliding control and duration are improved by her Passive - Drift . She can also deploy Kickstart , an enemy-seeking drone that displaces and stuns enemies.

abilities.name: Drift
abilities.description: Increased control while sliding.

abilities.name: Nitro Gate
abilities.description: Deploy a speed gate that sends users into a boosted slide.

abilities.name: Kickstart
abilities.description: Deploy an enemy-seeking drone that displaces targets on impact.

options.name: Sliding Shooter
options.description: Bullets shot while sliding come straight from inventory instead of magazine.

options.name: Long Haul
options.description: Increase Nitro Gate effect duration to 5 seconds (3s -> 5s).

options.name: Jump Gate
options.description: Upgrades the Nitro Gate to give a double-jump.

options.name: Super Slider
options.description: Reduce Nitro Gate cooldown by 5 seconds (25s -> 20s) and increase maximum in-world Nitro Gate amount by 1 (2 -> 3).
